claims.statement: QQQ uses the current official total expense ratio from the Invesco fund page.
IEMG uses the current official gross expense ratio from the iShares fund page.
SGOV uses the current official gross expense ratio from the iShares fund page.
QQQ historical drawdown is calculated from 10 years of Nasdaq daily closes with cash distributions reinvested.
IEMG historical drawdown is calculated from 10 years of official iShares daily NAV and ex-dividend data.
SGOV historical drawdown is calculated from all official iShares daily NAV and ex-dividend data available since inception.
BMNR historical drawdown is calculated from all Nasdaq daily closing-price data available for the current ticker.
BMNR identity and filing record are sourced from SEC EDGAR.
Broad macro score inputs use the 16 listed FRED series and Treasury data.
Correlated macro sentiment reweights the same 16 verified driver scores by transparent holding transmission coefficients and the optimized allocation.
US, Europe and Asia rankings are transparent portfolio-transmission scores, not stand-alone regional economic forecasts.
Gross CAGR, volatility, forecast uncertainty and relevance values are transparent assumptions, not externally verifiable facts.
The optimizer constrains the synchronized monthly-rebalanced portfolio path, named simultaneous stresses and correlated 10-year cap-breach probability.

The two-decimal macro rate sets a proportional 60%-80% SGOV cushion; allocation, observed portfolio drawdown, stress loss and correlated simulation are then recomputed by the transparent max-growth model.
